summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a new share repurchase program authorized by its board of directors. The program allows the company to repurchase up to US$300 million of its Class Z ordinary shares and/or ADSs over the next 24 months, effective June 24, 2026. Repurchases may be executed through open-market, privately negotiated, or block trades, including Rule 10b5-1 plans, funded from existing cash. The board retains the right to adjust terms periodically. This open-ended authorization signals management's view that shares are undervalued and aligns with a shareholder-friendly capital allocation strategy. Investors should monitor execution pace and any subsequent signals about cash deployment priorities.
